preserved_occurrence.function: Seals combustion gases and transfers heat toward the bore. Individual split ring; exact section profile is not yet reconstructed.

preserved_occurrence.function: Seals combustion gases and transfers heat toward the bore. Individual split ring; exact section profile is not yet reconstructed.

preserved_occurrence.name: Oil-control rail 2 · cylinder 1

preserved_occurrence.name: Oil-ring expander · cylinder 1
preserved_occurrence.function: Loads the oil rails outward. A split band represents this component; actual corrugations and oil-drain windows remain unmodeled.

preserved_occurrence.name: Wrist pin · cylinder 1
preserved_occurrence.function: Connects piston and rod at their small-end joint. Retainer configuration and offset need confirmation.

preserved_occurrence.name: Connecting rod · cylinder 1
preserved_occurrence.function: Transfers force between wrist pin and crank journal. Its angle is solved from the mechanism; center distance and forging profile are provisional.

preserved_occurrence.name: Rod cap · cylinder 1
preserved_occurrence.function: Closes the big end around the crank journal and lower bearing shell.

preserved_occurrence.name: Upper bearing shell · cylinder 1
preserved_occurrence.function: Supports the loaded side of the crank-journal interface. Separate from the rod forging.

preserved_occurrence.name: Lower bearing shell · cylinder 1
preserved_occurrence.function: Fits inside the removable cap. Oil film is an explanation, not a fluid simulation.
